methods.label: Find the common divisors of the totals
methods.explanation:
The price \(x\) must be positive, since a zero-dollar ticket cannot produce either positive total. Each total is \(x\) times an integer number of tickets, so \(x\) must divide both 48 and 64.

Any common divisor also divides \(64-48=16\). Conversely, every positive divisor of 16 divides both \(48=3\cdot16\) and \(64=4\cdot16\). Thus the possible prices are exactly
\[
1,\ 2,\ 4,\ 8,\ 16.
\]
Each works because \(48/x\) and \(64/x\) are positive integer ticket counts. There are \(\boxed{5}\) possible values, choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
